market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil above $100, yield spikes, and trade-war escalation. Expect elevated volatility (VIX likely 20+). Dow's 620-point drop signals risk-off rotation. Bessent's failed rate intervention creates policy uncertainty. Asian markets vulnerable to oil-driven inflation. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, range-bound with downside risk if Iran conflict escalates further.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook more constructive: bond yields at generational highs offer entry; AI capex cycle intact; defense spending structural; EM diversification (Indonesia, Philippines) attractive. Oil may normalize if Iran conflict de-escalates. Trade wars create structural shifts favoring domestic supply chains. Key risk: prolonged inflation forcing higher-for-longer rates.
